pages.text: Two $(l)supreme$() charms above the primordial, named in aqua. Each joins two primordial charms at the $(l)primordial altar$(), with the guardians' relics and a Primordial Heart.$(br2)$(l)Recipes$(): the White Tiger always drops Transparent World's, the Black Tortoise Untouched by Any Law's.$(br2)Every supreme charm: luck +100.

$(l)Transparent World$(): Omni Amplify + Fleeting Eternity$(br2)Attack, non-physical damage, attack speed, draw speed and projectile damage +200% each; ignores all armor, resistance and invulnerability; physical hits echo 75% as magic; homing, free arrows, targets frozen.$(br)$(l)Insight$(): 20% of hits see through their target: x2.5.

$(l)Untouched by Any Law$(): Unbreakable Principle + Spell Annulment$(br2)All damage -90%, armor +15, no knockback, immune to harmful effects; no physical hit above 20% of max health; 40% of non-physical harm reflected.$(br)$(l)Inviolate$(): a killing blow is refused, leaving 30% health and 3s of Resistance V, once a minute.
